pages.text: $(bold)Ammo Selection$()$(br2)Hold a cannon and hold $(bold)[Tab]$() to open the ammo wheel.$(br2)$(bold)Controls:$()$(br)• Move mouse to pick ammo type$(br)• Release Tab to confirm$(br)• Ammo is pulled from your ammo bay$(br2)R is manual reload, not the ammo wheel.

$(bold)Ammo Types:$()$(br)• $(item)HE Shell$() — Explosive area damage$(br)• $(item)AP Shell$() — Armor piercing, higher single-target damage$(br)• $(item)VT Shell$() — Proximity fuze, anti-air$(br)• $(item)Type 3 Shell$() — Pellet spread, crowd control$(br2)$(bold)Tip:$() The required ammo type must be in your ammo bay before switching!
